findings.title: Cached translations ignore changes to the site fallback locale
findings.body: Fallback results depend on `SiteSetting.default_locale`, but the translation accelerator caches by translation key and requested locale without including the fallback locale in its cache key. If an administrator changes the site default while the process is running, translations missing in a user's locale can keep returning text from the old default indefinitely, even though the new fallback translations are loaded.

findings.title: Fallback locales are loaded only for controller requests
findings.body: This is the only call that preloads fallback locales, so translations outside controller requests (for example, in a background job or mailer that switches to a user's locale) do not load the site-default or English catalogs. The translation accelerator loads only the current locale, and the fallback backend cannot find translations in catalogs that have not been loaded; such calls can return missing translations instead of falling back.
